documents.title: Introducción
documents.text: tt-inference-server tt-inference-server is the fastest way to deploy and test models for serving inference on Tenstorrent hardware.

documents.title: Quickstart guide
documents.text: On first-run please see the prerequisites guide for general Tenstorrent hardware and software setup. For the specific quickstart guide and details for your model, select your model and hardware configuration in Model Support pages and tables below. Alternatively you can see all models supported for your given Tenstorrent hardware.

documents.title: Development
documents.text: Developer documentation: docs/README.md Release documentation: scripts/release/README.md If you encounter setup or stability problems with any model please file an issue and our team will address it.

documents.title: docs/README.md
documents.text: Developer Documentation Directory of development docs for working on tt-inference-server. Getting Started - Workflows User Guide - Main entry point for using the run.py CLI, including requirements, CLI options, serving LLMs, benchmarks, evals, and reports - Workflow Runner - Detailed reference for the workflow runner CLI, execution modes, client-side scripts, and model configuration Development - Development - Git workflows, branching strategy, pre-commit setup, and release process - Add Support for New Model - Step-by-step guide for adding new model support, including evals and benchmark targets Testing & Debugging - Running vLLM Parameter Tests - How to run vLLM parameter-specific tests for development and debugging - Running TT-Triage - Using the TT-Triage debugging tool to diagnose system hangs on Tenstorrent hardware Benchmarking & Performance - Benchmarking Tools - Comprehensive guide to performance benchmarking tools (vLLM, GenAI-Perf, AIPerf) Model Configuration - Run Model on Specific Commit - How to run a model on a specific tt-metal or other dependency commit - Experimental Models - List of models with experimental status under active development Deployment - Multi-Host
